summary: Full backend + frontend QA for 'The Law of Silence' new feature set (unified items, market payment selector, black market cash-only, bank 10% fee, heists with stamina/capacity/prison, friends/messages/notifications, gang system + inventory, rankings, businesses collect). Added /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (24 tests covering all requested endpoints) and executed frontend Playwright smoke through Login → HUD → Market buy w/ modal (cash) → Inventory consume → BlackMarket cash-only → Bank fee preview → Heists success-chance → Prison → Social → Gang → Progress → Garage. All backend tests pass (29 passed, 3 rational skips). All frontend UI flows pass end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2022 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, market, heist, gang, social) for maintainability.
buy_drone endpoint (/drone/buy) mutates data.item_id then delegates; the mutation is a no-op — harmless but confusing dead code.

compute_success_chance uses find_item(NPCS, cid) for crew_ids but /heist/run does NOT verify the caller actually owns / has hired the passed crew NPCs. This could let a player pass any npc_id to inflate spec/crew bonuses. Recommend validating cid in user['hired_crew'] inside run_heist.

test_heist_capacity_gate: with unowned crew ids the API returns 400 for another reason (capacity or spec check) rather than a distinct 'unowned crew' error; the response reason is not distinguishable from capacity error.

Heist ‘capacity: -0.15’ penalty in compute_success_chance is applied even when vehicle_capacity is missing — vehicle ownership is only enforced in /heist/run, not the /heist/success-chance preview, so preview can leak info for unowned vehicles.

search_users only returns id via serialization? Currently it excludes id in the returned dict (see _return list comprehension). That's fine, but consider consistent id inclusion so frontend can link users.
Notifications 'mark read' uses id == 'all' magic string; consider a dedicated endpoint or clear API contract.

gang/inventory/withdraw does not enforce that the withdrawn item goes to the requesting user's inventory limits — infinite consumables possible via deposit/withdraw cycle by leader. Low-priority abuse vector.
Frontend BlackMarket.jsx correctly hides bank option; PaymentSelector.jsx displays a proper 'ILLEGAL ACTIVITY · CASH ONLY' warning when allowed=['cash'] only.

Frontend does not display a preview of computed 10% fee inside Market/Garage buy modal (PaymentSelector accepts feePct prop but Market.jsx passes 0). Only Bank tab shows a fee preview. Consider passing feePct=0 for market (correct — no fee on purchases) but confirming this is intended.

success_rate.backend: 100% (29/29 passing, 3 skipped due to insufficient starting cash)

seed_data_creation: Tests create fresh users with TEST_ email prefix per run; primary qa_main account used unchanged for frontend UI test (start cash mutated to $680 by end).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py cover all new endpoints and pass reliably. Frontend flows validated: login, market cash/bank selector, inventory consume, BM cash-only, bank fee preview (10%), heist success chance, prison, social/gang/progress/garage nav. Only recommendations are code-quality (see critical_code_review_comments) — no functional bugs found. If retesting, primary qa_main account cash is ~$680; may need to top up via /api/market/sell-contraband if running full flow again. Heist run may put the account in prison; use /api/prison/pay-bail (cash) to recover.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues discovered. Only note: crew validation gap in /heist/run (does not verify hired_crew ownership of NPCs passed as crew_ids). Recommend adding a guard: if cid not in user['hired_crew'] -> 400. Low risk since NPCs cost money to hire and success chance is capped at 92%.
